item.title: refactor(ui): share Control UI resource route contract (#126386)
item.summary: refactor(ui): share Control UI resource route contract (#126386) * refactor(ui): share Control UI resource route contract Gateway and Control UI now share browser-safe resource route grammar, while authorization and domain validation remain handler-owned. * perf(ui): keep resource routes out of startup Narrow browser-safe contract modules and the lazy authenticated avatar loader keep route/cache code out of the startup chunk while the stable Gateway barrel remains compatible.
